supporting_diagnostics.adaptation: Separate episodes; burn0; Welch nperseg=min(300,N), noverlap=nperseg//2; min32 controls; fixed5Hz fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth. High band=actions-lowpass(actions). Teacher-policy residual variance separately labelled. No pooled-state renormalization.
supporting_diagnostics.neighbour: 10 finite neighbors; distance-exclusion100 and whole-restart-trajectory-heldout controls; per-held-episode R2; negative and missing retained.
supporting_diagnostics.comparison: Different from original K1:1000 controls,burn100,Welch450/225,pooled source normalization. These are supporting explanations, not comparable thresholds or admission gates.

limitations: Four current-student restart contexts, not whole-task standalone policy evaluations or learning evidence.

Shadow preparation paid two preceding-state MPPI forecasts. Its recommendation was not executed: the actual student action connects that predecessor to the target context. This is a shadow nominal, not a teacher-owned MPC history.

T1 selected its coefficient from three states of the first source student episode. T0 case0 at control100 overlaps that calibration episode/state; cases1..3 were outside the T1 bank roster. This is not held-out confirmation.
Realized candidate spread ratios, survival mass, spectra and neighbor R2 are descriptive; none changes alpha, admits demonstrations or replaces executed outcomes.
